description: A MZC Creative Group é uma equipa multidisciplinar moçambicana que combina criatividade, tecnologia, comunicação e inovação para desenvolver soluções digitais com impacto. Participamos no NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 com o objectivo de transformar desafios espaciais em experiências educativas e interactivas. Procuramos talentos nas áreas de programação, desenvolvimento web, design, inteligência artificial, ciência, animação e exploração espacial.
summary: Junior Astronaut is a browser-based space science game for learners ages 7 to 14. From an orbital training station, players run experiments on Earth, compare gravity on the Moon, respond to a Martian dust storm, and pilot a probe through Venus’s atmosphere. NASA facts about gravity and planetary environments shape the choices players make. Short quizzes with feedback and end-of-mission reports help learners explain what they observed and give teachers material for classroom discussion. The game is available in English and Portuguese and can be downloaded for offline play.
details:
Players start by jumping and dropping a ball on Earth, then equip a mask and compare how long a jump lasts on the Moon. On Mars they respond to a dust storm while managing oxygen and power. On Venus they operate a probe from a protected module and decide when to stop its descent and transmit data before pressure damages it. Each mission turns facts about a planetary environment into decisions that affect the outcome.

The game offers three age levels (7–9, 10–12, and 13–14), feedback after quiz answers, and reports that record discoveries, observations, and decisions. Players can revisit or export their reports for classroom discussion. Teachers can unlock destinations to match their lessons.

The game uses HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Canvas. A Python build script packages the English edition, artwork, and audio into a single HTML file. Keyboard and touch controls support computers and phones. Both language editions can be downloaded for offline use.
